name: com.unity-skilled.skiasharp
description: SkiaSharp 2.88.9 managed assembly plus the win-x64 native binding, vendored locally so Unity-Skilled modules (e.g. UISourceGen) can draw with Skia without a NuGet restore. Managed DLL auto-assembles into the com.unity-skilled.skiasharp assembly; the native lib is placed under Plugins/x86_64 for Windows 64-bit.
